parameter: EIA 1.2 Air: NOx, CO, NH3 slip, SO2 and dust on light diesel oil (LDO, at most the annual hours of the EIA)
remarks: ALP-EPC-00000-HS-DBR-0001; ALP-EPC-00000-PR-LST-0003 (chemical consumption, effluent and emission inventory); LDO operating hours counter reported per section 4.
value_text: LDO limits are held as DP-OWNR-0041 (NOx), DP-EPCE-0009 (CO), DP-OWNR-0042 (SO2) and DP-OWNR-0043 (dust); the NH3 slip limit DP-CASE-0042 applies to both fuels; LDO operation is limited to the annual hours in DP-OWNR-0039 by the LDO management and reporting procedure; the LDO sulphur content DP-OWNR-0035 supports the SO2 limit.
